channel.title: Research Tape
channel.description: A daily AI-in-finance research tape: arXiv and SSRN, six items or fewer.

item.title: Trials-adjusted Out-of-Sample Gating for LLM-proposed Trading Strategies
item.description: No LLM-generated trading strategy survived out-of-sample validation with trials adjustment on real data.

item.title: Attributing Apparent AI Alpha: Factor Exposure, Leakage, Complexity, and Reasoning in Agentic Equity Research
item.description: Apparent AI alpha in equity selection is a benchmarking artifact, not skill.

item.title: AI Intermediation and Investor Information Processing: Evidence from Earnings Summaries on Social Media
item.description: AI summaries reduce retail investor opinion diversity but increase trading informativeness.

item.title: Agentic Empirical Asset Pricing: Methodological Foundations *
item.description: Agentic factor-discovery systems show inconsistent rankings across metrics and rolling re-executions.

item.title: AI Volatility Forecasts Under Stress: Performance, Tail Risk, and Ranking Reversals
item.description: Advanced volatility models deteriorate most during stress despite strong average-case performance metrics.

item.title: Canaries in the Gold Mine: Early Productivity Gains from Artificial Intelligence Creating Organization Capital
item.description: AI productivity emerges from building organization capital, not technology deployment alone.
